# Company Research

Every company and source is fictional.

- [Acme Cloudworks](acme-cloudworks/README.md) — current platform role and complete seven-file role dossier.
- [Clockwork Capybara Robotics](clockwork-capybara-robotics/README.md) — adjacent robotics domain and an old, partial exact-role hiring entry.

Each dossier owns company facts in `overview.md`, `business-and-products.md`, `technology-and-engineering.md`, `organization-and-culture.md`, `roles-and-hiring.md`, `risks-and-open-questions.md`, and `sources.md`.
